claims.claim: Very neat 2 seater couch for sale
claims.evidence: Witness confirms it is a light-colored upholstered 2-seater sofa with intact seams/piping, but also notes visible light staining/marks on the seat area.
No purchase date/receipt, tag, or other proof shown in the witness report.
Witness report notes light staining/marks on the seat area and faint marks on the seat.
Witness describes visible upholstery condition but does not report firmness/sag testing.
No smell/odor test or confirmation shown in the witness report.

risks.risk: Hidden odor (smoke/damp) or lingering smells not visible in photos
risks.proof: A short video clip of the seller opening/tilting the sofa to show underside and then a close-up sniff test (seller and buyer both confirm) plus a quick wipe test on fabric; or a video of the sofa being aired outdoors for a few minutes with no odor complaints.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used upholstered sofa with possible odor risk (worst case: treat as not guaranteed smoke-free).

risks.risk: Stains/marks may be more extensive than what’s visible (set-in stains, discoloration, or water marks)
risks.proof: A bright-flash close-up video of the entire seat panel, both arm areas, and the backrest, including edges and seams; plus a close-up of any stain spots from multiple angles.
risks.if_unproven: Price as having existing seat staining (worst case: needs cleaning).

risks.risk: Cushion sagging or weak foam not detectable from upholstery appearance
risks.proof: A clip showing the buyer pressing down firmly on the seat cushion (front and back) and releasing to demonstrate rebound; include a side angle to show any bottoming out.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possibly worn foam (worst case: reduced comfort/possible sag).

risks.risk: Frame/springs/underside issues (wobble, loose joints, broken springs) not visible from top photos
risks.proof: A video showing the sofa tipped slightly to reveal legs/underside and a gentle rocking test to demonstrate stability; include close-ups of joints and any support bars.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if frame/springs are unknown (worst case: potential structural wear).

risks.risk: Material type uncertainty (fabric vs PU/leather) affects cleaning method and durability
risks.proof: A close-up of the upholstery texture and an edge/corner where material layers are visible; ideally a small hidden underside photo showing backing/material label.
risks.if_unproven: Price as fabric/upholstery (worst case for cleaning and stain absorption).

risks.risk: Dimensions/fit uncertainty for the buyer’s space
risks.proof: A tape-measure photo/video showing length, width, height, and seat height from the floor to the cushion top.
risks.if_unproven: Price as standard used 2-seater without size certainty (worst case: may not fit).

proof_requests: Send a bright-flash video covering the full seat, both arms, and backrest (including seams/piping) to confirm the extent of staining/marks.
Show a cushion rebound test: press down firmly at the front and back of the seat and release (side angle).
Provide a short video of the underside/legs and a rocking test to confirm no wobble/loose joints or spring issues.
Confirm material type with close-ups (fabric vs PU/leather) and, if possible, a label/underside backing photo.
Provide dimensions (length/width/height and seat height) with a tape measure.
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies it as a light-colored upholstered 2-seater sofa and reports intact seams/piping but also visible seat staining/marks, which sets the worst-case condition for pricing despite unverified seller claims.
